name: Croft
description:
Croft turns Claude into your full-stack builder. Describe an app in plain language — a CRM, a habit tracker, an expense splitter — and Claude writes the code, deploys it to your private Croft workspace, and gives you a live URL. Your apps run on a server you own, stay private to you and the people you invite, and are versioned on every change so you can roll back anytime.

Key features
- Build by conversation — Claude scaffolds, writes, and iterates on real apps from a description.
- One-step deploy — every change is committed and shipped to a live,
- Live status & logs — check whether an app is up and read its runtime logs without leaving the chat.
- Secrets management — store API keys and env secrets encrypted, injected at deploy.
- Team access — invite people by email and grant per-app access; you stay in control of who sees what.
- Version history & rollback — every deploy is a release you can revert.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Croft to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Croft to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.oncroft.net/.

_published_faq.name: Is Croft MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Croft scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Croft MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Croft lists 19 MCP tools, including add_custom_domain, create_app, delete_app, deploy, get_app, get_platform_conventions, grant_access, invite_user, list_apps, list_secret_keys, list_users, and logs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Croft?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Croft in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Croft does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is Croft failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Croft scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Croft is developed by Croft. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
